name: Poisonous Mold
disable: DC 18 Survival check (trained) to safely remove the mold
reset: Unless entirely eradicated (typically with acid or fire), the mold regrows over the course of 2 weeks.

items.name: Feed on Decay
items.text: The mold expands when fed by blood or decay. If at any point a creature takes bleed damage while adjacent to the mold or a dying or dead body is adjacent to the mold, the mold grows to expand into every square adjacent to its current space. This can happen only once per day.

items.name: Spore Burst
items.text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature touches the mold, hits it, or damages it

---

Effect The mold explodes in a burst of spores and mold clusters, dealing 2d6+6 poison damage to creatures within 10 feet of it, with a DC 18 basic Fortitude save save.

items.name: Floating Spores
items.text: 5 feet. A creature that enters or starts its turn in the aura takes 2d6 poison damage.

text: This grotesque fungus releases poisonous spores when a creature comes near.
